_comment: The roles the lanes of this guide's business processes (input/business-processes/PHW.*.bpmn) name, each with the lane names it covers as otherNames; the description names the ActorDefinition in input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh it specializes, where one exists. Schema: cat-harness-tools/schemas/process/role-graph.ts. Every person is fictional.
name: smart-trust-phw

roles.title: Holder
roles.description: The person who holds a Personal Health Wallet, records consent, and presents verifiable health links and certificates. Specializes the ActorDefinition Holder (input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh).

roles.title: Consent Recorder
roles.description: The person or system that records a consent directive for the holder (IHE PCF Consent Recorder): the wallet itself, or a health worker on the holder's behalf.
otherNames: PCF Consent Recorder (wallet or health worker)

roles.title: Consent Registry
roles.description: Holds consent directives and answers IHE PCF [ITI-108] Access Consent. Specializes the ActorDefinition ConsentRegistry (input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh).

roles.title: VHL Sharer
roles.description: Holds the health information, generates verifiable health links, and enforces consent when a link is redeemed. Specializes the ActorDefinition Issuer (input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh).
otherNames: VHL Sharer (grouped with PCF Consent Recorder)

roles.title: Document Source
roles.description: The system that assembles a document about the holder before it is signed: the VHL Sharer when a document is shared, the Certificate Issuance Service when a certificate is issued. Adds the consent directives to it (process M).
otherNames: Document source (VHL Sharer or Certificate Issuance Service)

roles.title: VHL Receiver
roles.description: Receives a verifiable health link, checks its signature against the trust list, and retrieves the information. Specializes the ActorDefinition Receiver (input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh).

roles.title: Trust Anchor
roles.description: Publishes the trust list of keys that participants use to check signatures. GDHCN is one possible anchor among others. Specializes the ActorDefinition TrustNetworkAnchor (input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh).
otherNames: Trust Anchor (GDHCN or another accepted anchor)

roles.title: Certificate Issuer
roles.description: A health worker or issuing system that issues a verifiable digital health certificate. Specializes the ActorDefinition Issuer (input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh).
otherNames: Certificate Issuer (health worker or issuing system)

roles.title: Verifier
roles.description: Checks a certificate and its status, with or without a status checking application. Specializes the ActorDefinition Receiver (input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh).
otherNames: Verifier (with or without a status checking application)

roles.title: Data Provider Administrator
roles.description: The person at a data provider who registers clients under a data sharing agreement.

roles.title: Data Recipient System
roles.description: A server that accesses data under a data sharing agreement (OAuth client) and performs the agreement's duties.

roles.title: Provider Authorization Server
roles.description: Registers clients and decides access under a data sharing agreement (policy decision and enforcement).

roles.title: Auditor
roles.description: The person who reviews audit and provenance records under a data sharing agreement.
